## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Added failing tests in TDD order: e2e, integration, unit; then implementation (or explained why not applicable).
- [ ] Added or updated an OpenSpec change and its specs.
- [ ] Documented analytics events (PostHog), or confirmed none are needed.
- [ ] Documented data backup and restore implications, or confirmed no state changes.
- [ ] Added golden-set cases for AI changes and checked evals, fallbacks and reliability (or not applicable).
- [ ] Ran the focused mise task locally; CI checks pass.
- [ ] Listed new environment variables in `.env.example`, with no secrets committed.

## Validation and operational notes

Include relevant test evidence, skipped checks, backup notes and deployment follow-ups.
